name: Implement Queue using Stacks
description:
Implement a first in first out (FIFO) queue using only two stacks.

The implemented queue should support all standard queue operations: `Push(x)`, `Pop()`, `Peek()`, and `Empty()`.

complexity.time: O(1) amortized for Pop and Peek, O(1) for Push

hints: Use two slices as stacks: `inStack` for receiving incoming elements, and `outStack` for popping/peeking.
Push is straightforward: always append to `inStack`.
For Pop and Peek: if `outStack` is empty, transfer all elements from `inStack` to `outStack` (reversing their order). Then the top of `outStack` is the front of the queue!
